promise: Invest 5% of GDP annually in defence by 2035, including at least 3.5% on core defence and up to 1.5% on related security spending
description: At The Hague summit on June 25, 2025, NATO allies adopted the 2035 investment commitment. The target distinguishes core military expenditure from broader defence- and security-related investment.
evidence: NATO's official account confirms the target and 2035 horizon; final fulfillment is not yet due.

role: Parties to the UNFCCC Paris Agreement
promise: Provide at least $300 billion per year in climate finance to developing countries by 2035, with $1.3 trillion as the overall ambition
description: COP29 adopted the new finance goal early November 24 in Baku, still November 23 UTC: at least $300 billion annually by 2035 with developed countries taking the lead, alongside efforts to scale all-source finance to $1.3 trillion annually.
evidence: UNFCCC confirms the finance targets; their 2035 implementation horizon remains ahead.

promise: Achieve carbon neutrality across the entire battery value chain by 2035, with supplier carbon-footprint data required from 2027
description: CATL reiterated its 2035 value-chain carbon-neutrality goal in Ningde on August 17, 2026 and announced supplier carbon-footprint reporting requirements from 2027. It said all 20 battery plants had received carbon-neutral certification for its core-operations target.
evidence: CATL's August 17 release supports the roadmap and reporting requirement; core-operation certification does not establish value-chain neutrality.
